notes.title: Q&A with Hot Chili Games - Developers of Elypse
notes.content:
[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/09cfdd593bd2462c1b961d766dab523de010823a.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/6d06f8fe0436df090012b02dfc2ea4387a41f3c8.png[/img][/url]

[h1]So we had a lot of questions from the players who tried the game or heard about Elypse. We decided to pick and combine the most commonly asked questions from the community and here they are:[/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/0bc338e95c281370c6a2381064291d6a12748a8f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Is Elypse a Metroidvania?[/h2]
We got asked this question a lot and there were some initial misunderstandings/miscommunication and assumptions that it was a Metroidvania when the game was initially announced. We would just like to emphasize the fact that we never wanted to call it a Metroidvania and tried to avoid using the term. But everyone knows how the digital space is out of our control as a small team of indie game devs.

Honestly speaking, we drew inspirations from celebrated titles, including Ori and the Blind Forest, which influenced the aerial aspect of the controller, providing a sense of freedom and fluidity in movement. Celeste served as a structural blueprint, shaping the game's platforming challenges, and delivering a captivating narrative that unfolds with each step of the adventure. Taking cues from Super Meat Boy, Elypse features a dynamic controller and the exhilarating die-and-retry aspect, ensuring an adrenaline-fueled experience that will keep players hooked.

We tried our best infusing Elypse with their spirit while adding our own innovative gameplay elements. It's a fusion of platforming, challenging gameplay and storytelling that offers players a fresh and challenging adventure. While Elypse shares some artistic similarities with metroidvania games, it is more of an action-adventure 2D-Platformer, and we tried to offer a unique experience that sets it apart.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/b4db4279f2f3f4392ef17e741e1a9cd40b10263f.jpg[/img]

[h2]How many years and people did it take to work on Elypse?[/h2]
The journey of developing Elypse has been an incredible one, shaped by the passion and dedication of the talented team at Hot Chili Games. Over the course of two years, a close-knit group of friends and developers poured their hearts and souls into this project. Hot Chili Games, founded in 2020, brought together individuals who shared a common vision and an unwavering commitment to creating remarkable gaming experiences. 

We were five people in total, 1 producer, 2 artists and 2 developers. The actual game development took about 18 months. Through countless hours of hard work, collaboration, and overcoming challenges, Elypse has evolved into a labor of love that showcases the team's talent, creativity, and determination. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/865e3d9c5b5dedb2a51316faefb4924de12b663c.jpg[/img]

[h2]When is the console version coming out and does the PC version of the game support controllers and Steamdeck?[/h2]
Yes, the game has been out on PC since 17 May 2023, and it does support controllers. It is available on Steam, GoG, Epic stores. I think we got some player feedback about the game running smoothly on their Steamdeck. Also, we would like to add here that a lot of people were looking for the demo and as per tradition/usual, we took off the demo on the day of the release. 

Regarding the PlayStation and Nintendo Switch versions, while it's not officially confirmed, I can share with our curious and supportive community that they can expect it very soon, possibly within the next month.

[h1]If you have any other questions for the devs, don't hesitate to ask on the social channels.[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/ZMeTjqb6tX][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/641db702515bb689d839d355b45a983221c01fe8.png[/img][/url]
[h1][url=https://twitter.com/Hot_Chili_Games]Twitter: @Hot_Chili_Games[/url][/h1]

[h1]If you still haven't tried the game, here is the Steam Page:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725340/Elypse/

notes.title: The Countdown Continues
notes.content:
[h1]Uncover the fascinating STORY📖 of the Team behind Elypse! [/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/09cfdd593bd2462c1b961d766dab523de010823a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/6d06f8fe0436df090012b02dfc2ea4387a41f3c8.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Hot Chili Games, the team behind Elypse has poured everything they have into this project, from the beautifully crafted graphics to the hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack. And the story is truly something special. It's all about sacrifice, destiny, and fighting against the odds.

Elypse is an arduous 2D adventure, story rich platformer, in a mesmerising and mysterious world. In the game players take on the role of a female protagonist called Fay, chosen as the sacrifice to protect her people from the Abyss. But instead of taking it lying down, she chooses to fight back and search for a way to escape, possibly even saving everyone in the process.


[b]Maxime Chaize​ (CEO & Game director):[/b] Keeping company and game's vision to make it fun and spicy.

[b]Pierre-Louis Verguin​ (CTO & Game Programmer​):[/b] Working on development to create great games.​

[b]Elliot Blazy​ (Game Programmer & Level Designer):[/b] Fighting through scripts to get clean game experiences.

[b]Victor Mauduy​ (Artistic director & Animation)[/b]: Designing worlds and characters to please your eyes.

[b]Alexandre Framezelle​ (Game art & Technical art​​):[/b] Creating dope FX and shaders to enhance game's art.​

Lastly, for some context and a funny anecdote, the game Elypse used to be a student project that became into this cool game and a passion project for a small team of cool French developers. One of the game dev used to be an intern in the company which is now the publishing label for their debut title, believe it or not!

[/h3]

notes.title: The Countdown Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Uncover the captivating STORY📖 of Elypse!  [/h1]

[h3]Prepare for an emotional rollercoaster as you witness the power of determination and hope. Immerse yourself in a tale of sacrifice, destiny, and defying the odds. Join our brave heroine as she fights against the darkness and attempt to save herself and her people from the Abyss. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/1ed5ea14c9d9df48fba334540b243aa509fbdb37.png[/img]

[h3]Fay is a young servant of the imperial palace, She never knew her parents and has always grown up attending the Celestial court. Every ten years, a sacrifice is made by the emperor at the portal of the Abyss in order to maintain its seal and prevent creatures from leaving that world.

As a young adult, Fay finds herself designated to be sacrificed during the next ceremony. Determined to die for her people, she submits to her fate and dives into the Abyss, terrified but proud to know that she is saving her folks.

It was without being warned that it was not death awaiting her on the other side... But an adventure that would take her beyond anything Fay could have ever expected, accompanied by her future companion in misfortune, Nyx.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/a73b03d0d82e6ad23463f4da8f84172a7dd9c3a7.png[/img]

Nyx is a sky traveler who lost his people in an Abyss-related cataclysm.​
Wandering from city to city to learn more about the origin and manipulation of dark energy.​

Welcomed by the emperor of the Celestial people, Nyx was finally designated as the next sacrifice. ​
After many decades he will meet Fay, shattering the perspectives of the bitterly lonely man...​
[/h3]

[h2]🌟Only 2 days left until the release of Elypse! 🌟 [/h2]

[h3]The excitement is reaching its peak as we prepare to launch this 2D platformer. Sharpen your skills, gather your courage, and get ready to face the challenges that await you in the Abyss. It's time to show the world what you're made of! Let's make this a launch to remember! 🚀💥[/h3]

notes.title: Update & News concerning Elypse development.
notes.content:
Hey there,

So we figured that it could be interesting to keep you posted about where we are at concerning Elypse development.

Every feature of the game are complete and we are now working on polishing the game and optimizing it. As performance was an issue on the demo.

Among the many polishes we are doing to Elypse, we are working on some features that have been reported by you, players.

We tweaked the jump to have a better fit to the gamefeel and feedbacks, and last but not least we are implementing a camera panning for release.

Other than that we are starting to talk about release with our publishers.
We will, of course, keep you posted.

Cheers everyone!
- Hot Chili Games.

Best,
- Hot Chili Games.
